description: Causal forward price excursion and terminal event definitions for unconditioned regime health observations

units.probabilities: binary indicator {0, 1} at row level, empirical mean in grouped analysis

fields.remaining_mfe_to_flip_atr: Maximum favorable excursion (in ATR) achieved from timestamp t forward until regime terminates in opposite flip
fields.remaining_mae_to_flip_atr: Maximum adverse excursion (in ATR) suffered from timestamp t forward until regime terminates in opposite flip
fields.mfe_to_terminal_atr: Maximum favorable excursion (in ATR) from timestamp t until either NEW_MAX or FLIP occurs (competing horizon)
fields.mae_to_terminal_atr: Maximum adverse excursion (in ATR) from timestamp t until either NEW_MAX or FLIP occurs (competing horizon)
fields.p_new_max_before_flip: 1.0 if the active pullback episode terminates by re-extending to a new maximum MFE, 0.0 otherwise
fields.p_flip_before_new_max: 1.0 if the active pullback episode terminates by flipping to opposite regime, 0.0 otherwise
fields.time_to_new_max_seconds: Duration in seconds from timestamp t until NEW_MAX_MFE is established (NaN if FLIP occurred first)
fields.time_to_flip_seconds: Duration in seconds from timestamp t until regime flip occurs (NaN if NEW_MAX occurred first)
fields.time_to_terminal_competing_seconds: Duration in seconds until either competing terminal event resolves the episode
fields.mfe_30s_atr: Maximum favorable excursion within next 30s (or until regime flip)
fields.mae_30s_atr: Maximum adverse excursion within next 30s (or until regime flip)
fields.net_change_30s_atr: Directional return in ATR terms from price at t to price at t+30s
fields.additional_extension_atr: Max future MFE from regime start minus prior peak MFE (measures further trend expansion)
fields.giveback_from_subsequent_peak_atr: Drawdown in ATR from maximum achieved price after t to the terminal regime flip
fields.has_meaningful_extension: True if additional_extension_atr >= 0.50 ATR or episode establishes a new max MFE
fields.h1_recovery_confirmed: True if by timestamp t, H1 has declined >= 0.15 from its acute running peak (>= 0.60)
fields.h2_recovery_confirmed: True if by timestamp t, H2 has declined >= 0.15 from its acute running peak (>= 0.35)
fields.seconds_since_h1_recovery_confirm: Elapsed seconds since H1 recovery confirmation timestamp
fields.seconds_since_h2_recovery_confirm: Elapsed seconds since H2 recovery confirmation timestamp
